name: Nodocephalosaurus
sum: Nodocephalosaurus is an ankylosaurid from the Kirtland Formation of New Mexico, known from a partial skull with knobbed ornamentation.
wsnote: Estimates given in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: SMP VP-900, an incomplete skull and cranial fragments found in 1995 — De-na-zin Member, Kirtland Formation, New Mexico; held by the State Museum of Pennsylvania.
biology: Known only from the skull; no behavioural data.
author: Sullivan 1999
